title: Joint kernel in a principal two-open etale cohomology cover
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, X=Spec R [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and F an abelian sheaf on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For a,b in R and n>=0, assume H^n(D(ab(a+b)),F restricted to that open)=0 [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. If x in H^(n+1)(D(a+b),F restricted to that open) has zero pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] along each inclusion D(a(a+b))->D(a+b) and D(b(a+b))->D(a+b), then x=0. These are the actual cohomologyMap maps to iterated inverse-image coefficients; no assumption about vanishing on the two cover members is required.

source.place: Tag 0GY0, displayed Mayer--Vietoris exact segment and its final paragraph; Tag 0A50, construction of the etale Mayer--Vietoris sequence. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0GY0.

proof.text: Set W=D(a+b), U=W inverse image D(a), and V=W inverse image D(b). A prime avoiding a+b cannot contain both a and b, so U and V cover W. The isoImage and isoOfEq isomorphisms identify U with D(a(a+b)), V with D(b(a+b)), and their intersection with D(ab(a+b)). Compose with the open immersion W to Spec R to check these identifications.

Functoriality shows the two maps on W have zero images: each relative open inclusion factors as its isoImage isomorphism followed by the specified ambient homOfLE. The inverse-image composition comparison preserves and reflects zero. Apply the existing cohomologyPullbackFunctorial identity directly to each factorization and cancel the upperStarComp coefficient isomorphism; no duplicate composite-zero theorem is declared.

Use upperStarComp to identify the coefficients on the relative intersection with pullback of F restricted to D(ab(a+b)) along its scheme isomorphism. Cohomology is bijective along that isomorphism (a universal homeomorphism), and cohomology of isomorphic coefficient sheaves is isomorphic. Transport hprev to obtain a subsingleton intersection group.

Apply etale_mayerVietoris_connecting_pullback with g the identity of W and take its X-side exact segment in degrees n and n+1. Exactness writes x as delta(y). Since the intersection group is subsingleton, y=0, and additivity gives delta(0)=0. This works also for n=0 and for empty or repeated cover members.

theorem principalOpenCohomology_joint_kernel
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (F : Sheaf (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (a b : R) (n : ℕ)
    (hprev : Subsingleton (Sheaf.H
      (((Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
        (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (a * b * (a + b))))^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F) n))
    (x : Sheaf.H
      (((Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
        (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (a + b)))^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F) (n + 1))
    (ha : cohomologyMap
      (Scheme.homOfLE (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
        (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_mul_le_right a (a + b)))
      (((Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
        (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (a + b)))^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F) (n + 1) x = 0)
    (hb : cohomologyMap
      (Scheme.homOfLE (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
        (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_mul_le_right b (a + b)))
      (((Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
        (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (a + b)))^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F) (n + 1) x = 0) :
    x = 0
